summary.intent: Bundle three pending todos (#5 encrypt share itemName, #8 route shared-folder writes through SDK, #9 remove redundant web folder-seeding) into a single GSD phase, incorporating a newly discovered #498 regression as the P0 prerequisite, and advance to planning.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 ('SDK self-bootstrap regression fix and shared-folder/metadata consolidation') created on branch `feat/phase-48-sdk-self-bootstrap-fix-and-shares`, committed with enriched ROADMAP.md and STATE.md, web-e2e dispatch gate documented, and planning advanced through research completion and CONTEXT.md/VALIDATION.md artifacts committed.

repo: web-e2e only auto-triggers on push to `main` via `ci-e2e.yml` (paths-filter → workflow_call) — PRs and feature branches get no automatic web-e2e run, which is the gap that let PR #498 land with a regression.
PR #498 introduced a regression: `loadFolder` does an unconditional `folderTree.set()` that clobbers fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot — same desync class as PR #489.
Phase 47 covered owned-folder SDK consolidation (PR #494); Phase 48 is the shared-folder and share-metadata layer.
The server is zero-knowledge and cannot re-encrypt existing plaintext `itemName` values server-side — legacy data migration must be a lazy client-side backfill.

REQ-3 (shared-folder writes) resolved to a sibling `sharedFolderTree` keyed by `shareId` rather than extending `folderTree`, because shared folders carry a distinct `SharedWriteContext` and can collide on `ipnsName`.
TypeORM migration command for this project: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run`.
CRDT-IPNS inbox todo (#2) would subsume the itemName encryption fix (#5) if it ever shipped, but is explicitly deferred as long-horizon research.

code.finding: `loadFolder` calls `folderTree.set()` unconditionally, clobbering fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot. Fix: add a sequence-guard (`if existing.sequenceNumber >= resolved → keep existing`) before the set call.

Directly `workflow_dispatch`-enabled with `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}` — allows triggering against any pushed branch pre-merge via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>`.
Auto-trigger is `push: branches: [main]` only — this is the gap that allowed #498's regression to land undetected.

workflow: Pre-merge web-e2e dispatch: `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <fix-branch>` runs the identical job against a feature branch's HEAD without merging. Direct dispatch resolves repo secrets independently (no `secrets: inherit` parent needed).

When a todo's premise depends on a prior PR 'proving out in staging/prod,' verify that PR's CI status before treating the todo as unblocked — #9's deletion of safety-net seeders was gated on #498 which was actively regressing main.

CRDT/serverless architectural todos that would supersede open security findings should be cross-linked but never used to defer the security fix — the security item must be evaluated on its own merits.
